facts.summary: Interim data showed modest tumor responses, none in non-lung/esophageal tumors · Phase 1 · PRT3789 in SMARCA4-mutated solid tumors · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Overall, of the 26 advanced, heavily pre-treated NSCLC or esophageal patients evaluable for efficacy, 7 had tumor shrinkage. RECIST confirmed partial responses (PRs) were observed in 3 patients.
evidence.safety: No dose limiting toxicities were observed and no study drug-related serious adverse events were reported.
